name: health-evidence-companion
description: Evidence-based medical and adult psychological education with separate private-record workflows.

interface.longDescription: Medical and adult psychological education with separate owner-authorized private-record workflows. Nineteen skills add lay first aid, nutrition review, verified care navigation and focused history to the existing medical and psychological routes. The clinical navigation library connects anatomy, common symptoms, medicine/therapy classes, chronic conditions, tests, life stages, endometriosis, neuroscience and ageing to current source searches. Detailed birth-to-under-five references add illness, preventive care, developmental surveillance and fontanel/head-growth assessment. Source records preserve actual reading depth, jurisdiction and uncertainty. Standard treatment options prepare clinician questions; no individualized prescription, remote diagnosis or clinical clearance is provided. First-aid cards prioritize immediate lay actions and local dispatch. Existing records and psychological journals remain separate. The package has no publisher backend, patient telemetry, automatic account access or validated clinical engine. New therapeutic approvals, trial evidence and remaining gaps are distinguished. Host capabilities and chosen storage controls apply.
capabilities: Discuss optional CBT, ACT and MCT practices
defaultPrompt: Help me understand this health concern and prepare clinician questions.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.8.0 adds detailed birth-to-under-five pediatric illness, preventive care, procedures, vaccination navigation, growth/development and fontanel/skull assessment references. It preserves age, jurisdiction and source-reading limits; no clinical certification or automatic installed-copy update is claimed.
